title: Deployment Console configuration
description: Optional. Discovery works without this file; it only adds what AWS can't tell the console. See docs/configuration.md.

environments.description: Pin environment ids to ECS clusters (or to a docker compose EC2 box) and override what discovery decided.

host.description: EC2 instance id of a box that runs this environment with docker compose; its apps are the workloads whose env is this id

protected.description: Production-like: typed confirmations, reasons, operator role

branch.description: Git branch that deploys to this environment

databases.description: RDS instance ids that belong here

routes.description: Ingress host → service when there is no load balancer (reverse proxy)

region.description: The region of the cluster (multi-region: pins this id to the cluster of that name in that region)

discoverClusters.description: false = only clusters listed under environments

healthcheck.description: http(s) URL probed live (HTTP 200 = up), or one per environment id; anything else is reported and never probed

externals.description: Systems outside AWS to show on the map.

connections.description: Dependencies AWS can't show. from/to: service:<name>, database:<id>, cache:<id>, ext:<id>, or ingress | db | cache.

pricing.description: List prices for the Costs page's run-rate estimate (defaults: us-east-1 on-demand).

fargateVcpuHour.description: USD per vCPU-hour (x86; ARM is 20% less)

multiplier.description: Applied to every estimate, e.g. 1.1 for a pricier region

costs.description: Actual spend from AWS Cost Explorer (Costs page).

tagKey.description: Cost allocation tag that splits spend by environment

spikePercent.description: Flag services whose last-7-day average is this % above the prior 21 days

cacheHours.description: Hours between Cost Explorer snapshots (each costs about $0.04)

provisioning.description: Create & scale: copying services, scaling, one-off tasks, EC2 hosts (docs/provisioning.md).

enabled.description: false = no create, scale, run-task or add-host; deleting what the console created stays possible

maxTasks.description: Most tasks a service may be created or scaled to

maxHosts.description: Most console-created EC2 hosts per environment

allowedInstanceTypes.description: When set, new EC2 hosts must use one of these instance types

allowedImageRegistries.description: When set, image overrides in Copy a service must come from one of these registries (a host, or host/path prefix such as ghcr.io/acme). Recommended: your own ECR registry.

workloads.description: Apps AWS can't see as services (docker compose on an EC2 box, another platform), shown on the cloud map with a live health check. Keyed by id (lower-case, dashes).

host.description: EC2 instance id it runs on

platform.description: Shown as-is, e.g. docker compose, Railway

healthcheck.description: http(s) URL probed live; HTTP 200 = up

url.description: Where it answers; its hostname links DNS records and CDNs to it

uses.description: What it talks to: resource keys (rds:my-db), names, hostnames, ARNs or other workload ids

idleDays.description: A resource with no activity for this many days is marked idle

unassignedProtected.description: Resources placed in no environment follow the protected rules for actions (typed name + reason, the protected role). false = treat them like an unprotected environment

regions.description: Regions the console reads, home (AWS_REGION) first; CONSOLE_REGIONS wins over this. A list of at most 30 region codes, or "all-enabled" for every region enabled in the account (ec2:DescribeRegions)

providers.description: Which cloud-map providers run (ids as in Settings → Permissions, e.g. "lambda")

catchAll.description: Opt-in sources for resources no dedicated provider reads

config.description: Also read AWS Config's resource inventory (needs a configuration recorder)

cloudControlTypes.description: CloudFormation type names to list through Cloud Control, e.g. AWS::Glue::Database

deployments.description: Workflows that deploy, bound by file path: re-running one is a deploy to its environment whatever the workflow is called

inputs.description: workflow_dispatch inputs that select this environment, when one workflow deploys several
